shortBulletSummary: Crypto markets plunged with over $1.9B in long liquidations in 24 hours as Bitcoin fell below $65,000.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index hit 'Extreme Fear' with a score of 21-25, highlighting widespread investor anxiety.
Higher-than-expected US inflation data increased fears of Federal Reserve rate hikes, dampening crypto demand.
US FinCEN rescinded a proposed rule that would have lowered the crypto transfer reporting threshold to $250, reducing compliance burdens.
The US Digital Asset Market Clarity Act has stalled in Congress as legislative focus shifts toward confirming regulatory nominees.
